_status: RESEARCH CANDIDATE — NOT PRODUCTION. Source-backed TOPOLOGY only. No metres. Not loaded by the app.
source_policy: Every node and edge is traced from the official Menlyn Park Lower First Level map (first-party). Coordinates are measured on that image and expressed as scale-invariant percentages. No distance in metres is claimed because the map carries no scale bar. The exact Clicks storefront door is not depicted at usable resolution and requires field verification.
coordinate_system: percent-based MallMind node coordinates (0..100) on the PREPARED plan image (source image padded symmetrically in width to the 1000:620 plane). Canonical measurements are also given on the unpadded source image as *_source fields.

source_image.measured_on: conversation-rendered copy of the official JPG (uploaded by mission owner 2026-09-03)
source_image.measurement_precision_note: Positions read from the rendered image, not from native pixels: estimated ±8 px of the 1280-wide rendering (≈ ±0.6 % x, ±1.0 % y). Re-measure on the native file before on-site use; percentages are scale-invariant so the values below remain valid if the native aspect is 1.50.

_distance_unit_note: NOT in the current MallMind contract (which requires distance_meters > 0). Edges carry length_px_source (pixels on the 1280-wide rendering) and length_pct (percent of source width, scale-invariant). distance_meters is deliberately null: no calibration exists. See README for the smallest contract change.

plan_image.source: To be PREPARED from the source_image: pad width symmetrically to aspect 1000:620 (for a 1280×853 source: 1376×853, 48 px each side). url stays null until reproduction rights are confirmed with Pareto / centre management.

route_sequence: Start at Entrance 13 (Orange Parking / Atterbury Road side).
Walk straight into the mall along the corridor (south).
Continue straight across the cross corridor.
Clicks (LF 72) is on your right, just past the crossing. Arrival point: corridor abreast of Clicks.

wall_corridor_validation.pass_1: All three nodes lie on the same vertical tan corridor band (x ≈ 636 source px). Edge 1 is bounded by mr price home (west) and Ackermans (east) store blocks and never enters either. Edge 2 is bounded by the Clicks block (west) and an unlabelled block (east). No diagonal, no wall crossing, one junction included, no junction skipped (no other cross corridor between y 205 and y 355).
wall_corridor_validation.pass_2: Re-read from the entrance downward: marker 13 → corridor mouth → uninterrupted band → circular junction at the east–west corridor → band continues → Clicks logo abreast to the west → band continues to the lower east–west corridor (not part of the route). Consistent with pass 1. Rejected alternative: routing via the upper cross corridor westward — unnecessary, Clicks is reached without turning.
wall_corridor_validation.result: PASS (topology). Precision caveat: measured on a 1280-px rendering, not native pixels.
